payload.ai_prompt_keywords: Design a real-time monitoring dashboard. Use: live status indicators (pulsing), streaming charts, alert notifications, connection status, auto-refresh indicators, critical alerts prominent, system health overview.
payload.best_for: System monitoring dashboards, DevOps dashboards, real-time analytics, stock market dashboards, live event tracking
payload.css_technical_keywords: animation: pulse for live, WebSocket for streaming, position: fixed for alerts, status-dot with animation, chart real-time updates, notification toast, connection indicator
payload.do_not_use_for: Historical analysis, long-term trend reports, archived data dashboards
payload.effects_and_animation: Real-time chart animations, alert pulse/glow, status indicator blink animation, smooth data stream updates, loading effect
payload.implementation_checklist: ☐ Live updates working, ☐ Alert sounds optional, ☐ Connection status shown, ☐ Auto-refresh indicated, ☐ Critical alerts prominent, ☐ Offline fallback
payload.keywords: Live data updates, status indicators, alert notifications, streaming data visualization, active monitoring, streaming charts
payload.primary_colors: Alert colors: critical (red #FF0000), warning (orange #FFA500), normal (green #22C55E), updating (blue animation)
payload.secondary_colors: Status indicator colors, chart line colors varying by metric, streaming data highlight colors
